liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Second set opens with a monster Scarlet into Fire; Garcia's transition between the two is singled out as artistry; Reviewer found the Scarlet-Fire stunning, with many surprises still to come in the show [14][19][20]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Opening Bertha into Promised Land has a speedball feel, with Lesh pushing the modest outdoor theatre's structure [13]
- **Promised Land** (1 other source): The shnid 9994 source patches a one-second gap in Promised Land, and sounds like Sennheiser mics [5]
- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Garcia scrambled lyrics in Dupree's and Sugaree [22]
- **Cold Rain & Snow** (1 review): There is a dropout at the start of Cold Rain & Snow [17]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Garcia's solo in Hell in a Bucket ran a full half measure behind the band [22]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Garcia fumbled the Sugaree lyrics; reviewer thinks Brent's voice could have suited singing lead on it [21]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One is called one of the hottest of the 1980s [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-06-27.148046.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1983-06-27.141770.fob.senn441.silberman.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min [3]
- **gd1983-06-27.fob.senn441.miller.89790.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 4.38/5 by 8 [5]
- **gd83-06-27.aud.dodd.9994.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 149 min; rated 3.88/5 by 16 [6]. Said about its sound: Gutty audience tape recorded deep in general admission, with sweet Garcia vocals and powerful Lesh bass; Second-generation audience tape that is quite hissy, but instruments and vocals have good presence; Decent sound quality, though a bit hissy [13][17][20]

## Around the show

- Reviewer describes summer-time camaraderie, with a few songs turning up in unusual spots in the setlist [13]
- Chicago-area fans over thirty reportedly still miss Poplar Creek Music Theater, since replaced by something else [14]
- Poplar Creek shows fell on Monday and Tuesday, so the reviewer, otherwise on summer tour vacation, had to work [22]
- Attendee on acid during Scarlet-Fire saw a man in front painting in a notebook as the music played [23]
- Garcia's voice is in good form with plenty of inflection that night [24]
- Show has a strong East Coast-style feel, meaty and substantial, with ominous power building, reflecting the darker mood of the band's coming years [16]
- Sugaree is compared favorably with the Lake Placid show later in 1983 [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-06-27.148046.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M [1]. Also: Master recording by Chris Hecht, transferred by Charlie Miller, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones; A Sennheiser 441 source, shnid 89790, supplies short patches in the Truckin' to Drums transition and in Space [1]
- **gd1983-06-27.141770.fob.senn441.silberman.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Jeff Silberman and Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sennheiser 441 mics > Canare Cable > Technics SV100 PCM > Panasonic VHSTaper: Timon Malloy (friend of Jeff Silberman) Master Audience PCM(Had been… [3]. Also: Audience source shnid 9994, from Paul B. and Ernie Dodd, supplies the first forty seconds of Bertha and fixes dropouts [3]
- **gd1983-06-27.fob.senn441.miller.89790.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sennheiser 441 -> PCM [5]. Also: Audience source shnid 9994 came from unknown mics to cassette master, cassette, DAT, then CD [5]
- **gd83-06-27.aud.dodd.9994.sbeok.shnf**: source: Aud>Cass Master>C>DAT>CDR [6]. Also: Reviewer got a marginal audience cassette soon after the show and played it until it wore out [16]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bobbie Bestic Grateful Dead: [1983-06-28 Poplar Creek Music Theater, Hofman Estates, IL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1983-06-28-poplar-creek-music-theater-hofman-estates-il-usa/) [27]
- Poster by Bobbie Bestic Grateful Dead: [1983-06-27 Poplar Creek Music Theater, Hofman Estates, IL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1983-06-27-poplar-creek-music-theater-hofman-estates-il-usa/) [28]
